seoTitle: NYCPS Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Recess Dates & PDF
seoDescription: View the NYCPS 2025-2026 school calendar with first day, last day, holidays, winter recess, midwinter recess, spring recess, parent-teacher conferences, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: New York City Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on September 4, 2025 and ends on June 26, 2026. Winter Recess runs December 24, 2025 through January 2, 2026. Midwinter Recess runs February 16-20, 2026, and Spring Recess runs April 2-10, 2026. The NYCPS calendar includes school closures, parent-teacher conferences, Regents Administration windows, clerical days, and staff development days. Families should confirm private, parochial, charter, NYCEEC, Family Childcare, and school-specific dates directly with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When does NYCPS start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: New York City Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on Thursday, September 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is NYCPS Winter Recess in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs Wednesday, December 24, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is NYCPS Midwinter Recess in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Midwinter Recess runs Monday, February 16 through Friday, February 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is NYCPS Spring Recess in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Thursday, April 2 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for NYCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Friday, June 26, 2026.

yearNumbers.label: First Day
yearNumbers.detail: Students begin the 2025-2026 NYCPS school year on September 4, 2025.

yearNumbers.label: Winter Recess
yearNumbers.detail: Winter Recess spans late December and early January.

yearNumbers.label: Last Day
yearNumbers.detail: The official NYCPS calendar lists June 26, 2026 as the last day for students.
